evidence.quote: Data quality check: 508 orders with run_date 2026-10-20 have an order_ts outside 2026-10-20 (UTC)
evidence.why: Alert message shows 508 orders fetched for run_date 2026-10-20 had timestamps outside that UTC date.
The loader configuration uses local time zone bucketing instead of UTC, causing date boundary mismatches.

args.root_cause: The pipeline configuration specifies bucket_timezone: local in the loader settings, which groups orders into run_dates based on local time rather than UTC. This shifts orders across day boundaries relative to their UTC order_ts, triggering the date_consistency alert.
args.suggested_fix: Change bucket_timezone from local to UTC in pipeline.yaml under the loader section.
